solver_notes: Native C11/pthreads lifetime-race regression model executed on the physical aarch64 Cortex-A72; this is not a claimed upstream CPython patch. A deterministic two-thread schedule suspends a daemon thread at the PyEval_SaveThread-style GIL-release window while interpreter deletion runs. The legacy path mutates the interpreter list without requiring head_mutex and holds only a borrowed tstate pointer; poisoning the still-allocated model object deterministically exposes the stale access without invoking C undefined behavior. The fixed path takes a daemon-owned tstate reference before the release window, requires head_mutex for list unlinking, and uses 32-bit acq_rel atomic decrements: deletion observes previous refcount 2 and retains the object, while the daemon observes previous refcount 1 and performs final destruction only after its valid access. Five repeated runs, 1,000 threaded stress schedules per run, seven compatibility pytest checks, and UBSan pass. Scope is this interpreter-list/tstate-lifetime model; upstream CPython integration and all subinterpreter lifecycle paths are not claimed.
